pages.text: 春天的早晨，阳光暖暖地照进窗户。咘咘睁开眼睛，看到爸爸妈妈已经穿好了漂亮的衣服。
pages.text_en: On a warm spring morning, sunlight streamed through the window. Bubu opened her eyes and saw Mom and Dad already dressed up.

pages.text: 「爸爸妈妈，你们要去哪里呀？」咘咘揉揉眼睛问。「我们要去上班啦，宝贝。」妈妈温柔地说。
pages.text_en: Where are you going, Mom and Dad? Bubu rubbed her eyes and asked. We're going to work, sweetheart, Mom said gently.

pages.text: 咘咘的嘴巴一瘪，小手紧紧抱住爸爸的腿。「不要走嘛……咘咘想和爸爸妈妈在一起。」
pages.text_en: Bubu's lip quivered. She wrapped her little arms tightly around Dad's leg. Don't go... I want to stay with you.

pages.text: 妈妈蹲下来，轻轻抱住咘咘。「宝贝，你看窗外的太阳公公。」咘咘抬头看向窗外金色的阳光。
pages.text_en: Mom knelt down and hugged Bubu gently. Sweetheart, look at the sun outside. Bubu looked up at the golden sunlight through the window.

pages.text: 「想爸爸妈妈的时候，就看看太阳。我们在太阳下面工作呢，太阳会帮咘咘把想念传给我们哦！」
pages.text_en: Whenever you miss us, just look at the sun. We're working under the same sun, and it will carry your love to us!

pages.text: 爸爸在咘咘的手心轻轻亲了一下。「爸爸把一个亲亲放在这里。想爸爸的时候，就把小手贴在脸上。」
pages.text_en: Dad kissed Bubu's little palm softly. I'm putting a kiss right here. When you miss me, just press your hand to your cheek.

pages.text: 咘咘紧紧握住小拳头，认真地点点头。「那咘咘也给爸爸妈妈一人一个亲亲！」她踮起脚亲了爸爸妈妈。
pages.text_en: Bubu squeezed her little fist tight and nodded seriously. Then I'll give you each a kiss too! She stood on tiptoes and kissed Mom and Dad.

pages.text: 爸爸妈妈出门了。咘咘站在门口挥手：「拜拜！晚上见！」NOMI和NONO在旁边陪着她。
pages.text_en: Mom and Dad headed out the door. Bubu waved from the doorway: Bye-bye! See you tonight! NOMI and NONO stood right beside her.

pages.text: 外婆牵着咘咘的手说：「走，我们去画画！」咘咘画了一幅画：太阳下面，爸爸妈妈在笑，咘咘在家里挥手。
pages.text_en: Grandma took Bubu's hand. Come, let's go paint! Bubu drew a picture: under the sun, Mom and Dad smiling, and Bubu waving from home.

pages.text: 下午，咘咘和NOMI搭积木，NONO在积木上跳来跳去。外婆在旁边笑着看。「我要搭一个城堡送给爸爸妈妈！」
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu built blocks with NOMI while NONO hopped around on them. Grandma watched with a smile. I'm building a castle for Mom and Dad!

pages.text: 傍晚，门铃响了！咘咘飞奔过去。「爸爸妈妈回来啦！」她张开小手扑进爸爸妈妈的怀里。
pages.text_en: In the evening, the doorbell rang! Bubu dashed to the door. Mom and Dad are home! She leaped into their open arms.

pages.text: 一家人坐在沙发上。咘咘把画和积木城堡给爸爸妈妈看。「这是我今天做的！太阳帮我把想念都传给你们了！」爸爸妈妈紧紧抱住咘咘，笑得好幸福。
pages.text_en: The whole family sat on the sofa. Bubu showed Mom and Dad her painting and block castle. Look what I made today! The sun carried all my love to you! Mom and Dad held Bubu tight, smiling with pure happiness.
